title: Intended-pairing map
description: tokens/pairings.json — explicit fg/bg token pairs the system intends to be used together (#87). Checked against base + every brand by validate.mjs and validate_brand.

fg.description: Dotted token path of the foreground (text or edge) color.

bg.description: Dotted token path of the background the fg sits on.

kind.description: text → WCAG AA 4.5:1; non-text → SC 1.4.11 3:1 (interactive edges, focus indicators).

context.description: Where this pairing renders — the human reason the pair exists.

excludeBrands.description: Brands that never render this pair (document why in $excludeBrands-note).

exclusions.description: Pairs a brand is scoped out of whatever named them (#216) — the escape hatch for a CONVENTION-derived pair the brand does not render, which excludeBrands cannot reach because there is no map entry to flag. Not a place to park a failing pair: every entry must name who confirmed the pair is unrendered and carry the measured ratio.

brands.description: Brands this pair is excluded from.

ratio.description: The measured contrast ratio at the time of exclusion — what a future reader would inherit if they ever did render this pair.

confirmedBy.description: Who confirmed the pair is not rendered, and when. An exclusion is a claim about the product, not about the tokens, so it needs a source.

reason.description: Why this pair is never drawn. Must describe the UI, not the ratio.
